title: Engineering Journey
tagline: How a curiosity for fundamental systems evolved into building compilers, Android engines, and technical software.

milestones.summary: Started programming by writing C and Python scripts. Focused on foundational computing concepts: memory models, pointers, algorithms, and command-line interfaces.
milestones.highlight: Built first algorithmic scripts and learned the value of understanding the machine from low levels.

milestones.summary: Expanded into client-side application development using Flutter and Dart. Shipped first mobile user interfaces and explored responsive layouts and local state management.
milestones.highlight: Developed Aurora Music prototype, learning audio routing, background services, and reactive mobile architectures.

milestones.summary: Dived deeply into Rust for memory safety without garbage collection. Simultaneously explored 3D graphics on the web with WebGL, Three.js, and GLSL shaders.
milestones.highlight: Created ARC Reactor 3D and Solar System simulations, mastering coordinate systems, matrix transformations, and GPU render loops.

milestones.summary: Challenged myself to build complex multi-layered software. Built NovOS (a full web operating system with window manager and POSIX virtual filesystem in IndexedDB) and began engineering TechScript.
milestones.highlight: Wrote the initial lexer, recursive descent parser, and AST engine for TechScript entirely in Rust.

milestones.summary: Engineered and published KinotiX: 4K Live & 3D Wallpaper to the Google Play Store, managing real sensor-driven render loops and Android lifecycle constraints. Initiated development on Satvora AI.
milestones.highlight: Achieved production release on Google Play with KinotiX (Developer ID: 8946471561851740040) and initiated closed testing for Satvora AI.

milestones.summary: Launched the TechScript 2.0 language specification with stack-based bytecode VM, package management foundation, and CLI driver. Optimizing Satvora AI across Indian regional food taxonomies.
milestones.highlight: Actively advancing compiler tooling and maintaining verified Android products on the public market.
